article.title: Ultrahuman unveils Ring PRO & Jade AI health coach
article.description: Ultrahuman debuts Ring PRO smart ring and Jade AI, promising weeks-long battery life and real-time health guidance across its ecosystem.
article.content:
Ultrahuman has launched its third-generation smart ring, Ring PRO, and introduced Jade, an AI feature designed to interpret health signals in real time and trigger actions within its app ecosystem.
